help: splice a node into an arrow, between the two ends of it (e.g. node insert melody OUT wah)

readable.en: Splice a node into a chain
readable.fr: Insérer un nœud dans une chaîne

args.name: before
args.hint: the node the arrow LEAVES — the spliced one goes after it

args.name: after
args.hint: the node the arrow ENTERS — the spliced one goes before it

args.name: at
args.hint: optional — x,y world px: the node is drawn there (the web fills the click)

help: hand every node back to the automatic layout (clears all pinned positions)

readable.en: Re-lay out the whole graph
readable.fr: Réorganiser tout le graphe

help: record the layout's own positions (JSON {node: {x,y}}) — never overwrites a pin

readable.en: Record where the graph drew itself
readable.fr: Enregistrer où le graphe s'est dessiné

args.name: positions
args.hint: JSON {node: {x,y}} in world px — what the layout placed

help: move a node on the graph, world px (e.g. graph move reverb 420 180) — `auto` hands it back to the layout

readable.en: Pin a node's place on the graph
readable.fr: Épingler la position d'un nœud sur le graphe

args.name: x
args.hint: world px — or `auto` to hand it back to the layout

help: draw a new arrow from one node to another (e.g. graph chain connect gtr reverb, or splitter#b wet)

readable.en: Connect two nodes with a new cable
readable.fr: Relier deux nœuds par un nouveau câble

args.name: from
args.hint: the node the cable LEAVES — optionally name#port

args.name: to
args.hint: the node it plugs into — optionally name#port

help: remove the arrow from one node to another (e.g. graph chain disconnect gtr reverb)

readable.en: Remove one cable between two nodes
readable.fr: Retirer un câble entre deux nœuds

args.name: from
args.hint: the node the cable leaves — optionally name#port

args.name: to
args.hint: the node it plugs into — optionally name#port

help: re-plug an arrow (e.g. graph chain replug gtr reverb gtr delay — the gtr cable now feeds delay)

readable.en: Move one end of a cable to another node
readable.fr: Déplacer une extrémité d'un câble vers un autre nœud

args.name: from
args.hint: the arrow's current source — optionally name#port

args.name: to
args.hint: its current target

args.name: newFrom
args.hint: the source after the move (same, when the target end moved)

args.name: newTo
args.hint: the target after the move

help: start playback

readable.en: Start playback
readable.fr: Lancer la lecture

help: stop playback

readable.en: Stop playback
readable.fr: Arrêter la lecture

help: toggle playback

readable.en: Start or stop playback
readable.fr: Lancer ou arrêter la lecture

help: rewind to the start

readable.en: Rewind to the start
readable.fr: Revenir au début

help: silence every note and reset every plugin

readable.en: Silence everything (MIDI panic)
readable.fr: Tout faire taire (panique MIDI)

help: toggle the metronome (click during playback, bar starts emphasised)

readable.en: Turn the metronome on or off
readable.fr: Activer ou désactiver le métronome

help: set the metronome's level, 0.2..1 (e.g. transport metronome volume 0.4)

readable.en: Set the metronome's volume
readable.fr: Régler le volume du métronome

args.name: level
args.hint: 0.2 … 1 — off is `transport metronome`

help: toggle a track's record arm, or set it with on/off (armed tracks record on play)

readable.en: Arm a track for recording
readable.fr: Armer une piste pour l'enregistrement
